traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are fully implemented and verified. The plugin exposes a standard ESLint plugin structure (rules, configs, meta), is authored in TypeScript, dynamically registers multiple rules, provides ESLint v9 flat-config presets, and includes robust error handling around rule loading. Developer and user documentation clearly explain installation, configuration (including ESLint v9 flat config integration), and plugin development practices. All relevant Jest test suites tied to this story (plugin-setup, plugin-default-export-and-configs, flat-config integration, plugin-setup-error, and CLI error handling) pass in the latest test run, providing concrete evidence that the story’s acceptance criteria are met.
